Hi Aline / Optima privacy team — thanks again for the demo slot today. Quick recap and a few follow-ups so we can move toward a mutual action plan:

1) Clarify scope of PII: you flagged member identifiers (member_id, SSN in legacy imports), provider contact info, and free-text notes from claims intake. Can you confirm whether claimant notes are considered PII in scope for deletion requests?

2) Deletion/RTBF timeline ask: we discussed support for account-level delete requests initiated by Optima. Please confirm your SLA target (e.g., do you need <7 days, 14 days, 30 days?). We can offer a standard path and an expedited purge add-on — details below.

3) Backups & snapshots: we covered that snapshots are immutable for a window. I want to be explicit about the constraints and options so legal can sign off.

4) Residency: you mentioned primary residency in US-West. Is EU required for any subset of members?

Attachments: demo-recording.mp4 (link included in Drive), and I attached a short Redwood RTBF summary for your team to review (redwood-rtbf-summary.pdf).

Proposed next steps:
- Optima confirms PII scope + SLA target (reply in-line by end of week)
- Redwood provides draft mutual action plan and deletion manifest deliverable text by Mon, Nov 8
- Follow-up call to lock in timelines: Thu, Nov 11 or Fri, Nov 12 morning PT

If helpful, I can loop in Solutions Engineering for a brief technical call on how we handle KV cache and streaming logs.

Thanks — Aisha

Thanks Aisha — quick replies inline.

> 1) Clarify scope of PII: ... claimant notes from claims intake — are those PII?

Yes, claimant free-text intake is in scope. We classify free-text notes that contain contact or medical symptom references as PII. We will provide an export sample this afternoon.

> 2) Deletion/RTBF timeline ask: what SLA target?

We need a standard SLA of 14 calendar days for full account-level RTBF (primary store). For certain high-risk members we will request an expedited path (target 7 days) — that can be handled case-by-case.

> 3) Backups & snapshots: ... constraints and options

We cannot accept a 120-day immutable window. Our Security/Legal require backups to be purgeable within 60 days of a delete request unless there is a legal hold. We are open to a technical proof-of-deletion manifest for backups.

> 4) Residency: is EU required?

Not for this initial cohort — US-West is fine. We will revisit for EU members later.

Attaching our completed security questionnaire (Optima_Security_Questionnaire.pdf). Please confirm Redwood's answers where you can.

Best,
Aline

Hi Aline — thanks for the quick turnaround and the questionnaire. I did a pass on Optima_Security_Questionnaire.pdf and pulled out the parts relevant to RTBF/backups/residency. Below is a pragmatic proposal that aims to match your 14-day SLA request while accounting for immutable snapshot constraints.

Summary of proposed RTBF workflow (technical + operational):

- Scope: Primary store delete will include member identifiers, contact details, and free-text notes flagged as PII by Optima. Redwood will accept a CSV manifest (member_id list) or an API-triggered account-level delete.

- Primary purge SLA (standard): Redwood will remove PII from the active serving store within 14 calendar days from receipt of a validated delete manifest. Validation = schema + minimal checks (duplicates, account status).

- Expedited purge: For critical requests (e.g., regulator request or high-risk members), Redwood can expedite to 7 calendar days for an additional one-time fee or under enterprise committed contract terms.

- Backups & snapshots: Redwood performs weekly snapshots and incremental backups. Default immutable window is 45 days for backups, not 120. However, based on Optima's request we propose: backups purgeable within 60 days after request, with an option for an accelerated backup purge workflow (target 21 days) if Optima purchases the expedited purge add-on and provides a signed statement per purge. Legal holds will supersede purge requests.

- Proof of deletion: Redwood can provide a deletion manifest (hash + timestamp) for primary store purges within 48 hours of completion. For backups, we will provide a backup-purge log and a certificate of completion once purging tasks finish across snapshot copies (timing varies based on retention window and replication footprint).

- Logs & analytics: Redacted request logs are retained for 90 days by default; they do not contain raw PII unless explicitly enabled. We provide an audit bucket access for Optima SOC audits.

- Residency: Primary residency = us-west1. For EU residency we can enable a partitioned instance (separate tenant) — that would be part of a Private deployment conversation and would carry additional setup time.

Next operational steps we suggest (MVP path):
1) Optima confirms PII sample and approves 14-day primary purge SLA and 60-day backup purge window (or opts into the expedited backup purge add-on).
2) Redwood to draft the RTBF section for the mutual action plan (I will attach language suitable for your procurement/legal).
3) Run a dry-run deletion on a non-production subset (we recommend a 50-record test) to validate manifests and proof-of-deletion artifacts.

Attachments: I updated redwood-rtbf-summary.pdf with the timelines above and added sample manifest format.

If that lines up, Aisha can propose exact dates for the dry-run and the follow-up call.

-Marissa
